name: TokenManagement
description:
Enables administrators to get all tokens and delete tokens for other users. Admins can
either get every token, get a specific token by ID, or get all tokens for a particular user.

methods.name: CreateOboToken
methods.description: Creates a token on behalf of a service principal.

required_fields.description: Application ID of the service principal.

required_request_body_fields.description: Application ID of the service principal.

all_fields.name: application_id

all_fields.name: autoscope_enabled
all_fields.description: Whether to enable autoscoping for this token.

all_fields.name: comment
all_fields.description: Comment that describes the purpose of the token.

all_fields.name: lifetime_seconds
all_fields.description: The number of seconds before the token expires.

required_positional_arguments.name: application_id
required_positional_arguments.description: Application ID of the service principal.

required_in_url_fields.description: The ID of the token to revoke.

methods.name: GetPermissionLevels
methods.description: Gets the permission levels that a user can have on an object.

methods.name: GetPermissions
methods.description: Gets the permissions of all tokens. Tokens can inherit permissions from their root object.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all tokens associated with the specified workspace or user.

all_fields.name: created_by_id
all_fields.description: User ID of the user that created the token.

all_fields.name: created_by_username
all_fields.description: Username of the user that created the token.

methods.name: SetPermissions
methods.description: Sets permissions on an object, replacing existing permissions if they exist. Deletes all direct permissions if none are specified. Objects can inherit permissions from their root object.

methods.name: UpdatePermissions
methods.description: Updates the permissions on all tokens. Tokens can inherit permissions from their root object.

methods.name: UpdateTokenManagement
methods.description: Updates a token, specified by its ID.
